name: Perlego Partner API
description:
API for managing users and entitlements in Perlego.

All API calls must be made via HTTPS (TLS 1.3), must include a API key as a header, and must be hashed and signed (HMAC) for security. Keys will be provided to you by your Perlego account manager via a secure message prior.

Please note that in Staging and Development, this API is limited to a set of pre-agreed IP addresses or ranges. You will need to confirm these with your Perlego account manager prior.

Rate limits for the API are specified per path.
